verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms offline-first, local plain-text storage (docs-2, docs-20, docs-23) and Bases as a database-like filtering view on note properties (docs-6), plus tag-based linking (docs-18), which together imply some filterable retrieval. However, the pack contains no explicit documentation of Obsidian's full-text search engine, search operators for tags/paths, or performance claims about instant search across large vaults. Missing for 10: dedicated full-text search docs, tag/path/property query syntax evidence, independent hands-on confirmation of search speed/completeness.
